programme.desc: Part-time panto dame Graham Smith welcomes his rivals to the Georgian House and Mews in York. But some of his guests make hair-raising discoveries in their rooms.

programme.title: Champions: Full Gallop
programme.desc: After landing an unprecedented one-two-three and £860,000 in prize money in the Grand National, the chase is on for Willie Mullins to secure back-to-back British trainers' titles. Standing in his way are the Skelton brothers, trainer Dan and jockey Harry who are bidding for the double. Can the Irish maestro pull off another late charge and etch his name even deeper into racing folklore?

programme.title: The Motorbike Show
programme.desc: Henry Cole rides through the Cotswolds on some of his favourite roads, tells the story of the Yamaha V-Max, meets top rider Maria Costello and brings the restoration of his Suzuki JiXR to its climax with the help of Allen Millyard

programme.title: Night Vision
programme.desc: News, sport and weather from across Scotland

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts as Lee steps up to try to win big and leave the Banker worse off. Can he stay strong and turn down the Banker's cunning offers to take home what's in his box, or will be tempted to 'Deal' and go home early?

programme.title: James Martin's Great British Adventure
programme.desc: Still in Hampshire, James views ex-formula one racer Jody Scheckter's epic car collection, and learns of his passion for buffalo mozzarella, which he makes in his dairy. James uses some of the cheese in his buffalo mozzarella, blackberry and beetroot salad, before crossing into Sussex to don fancy dress and experience the Goodwood Revival, which celebrates motorsport from the 1940s to the 1960s. The presenter offers a classic comfort recipe - roast pork with black pudding fritters and caramelised apples as he prepares to watch some of his friends race in the Goodwood Revival TT race

programme.title: Love Your Garden
programme.desc: Alan Titchmarsh and his team of experts travel the country to find the dream gardens we'd all like to have. Meeting the colourful characters that create these spaces, they'll show us how we can live the dream at home.

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Alan is joined by Queen guitarist Brian May, cricket pundit Phil Tufnell and actress Denise Black, while Camilla Bassett-Smith shows how to heat up greenhouses in winter. There is a visit to Folly Wildlife Rescue to see the release of some sparrowhawks, and drinks expert Tom Surgey has a sticky liqueur special

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: A round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James serves up a feast of food for broadcaster Nicky Campbell with help from chefs Emily Scott and Stephen Terry, and there are cocktails from First Dates barman Merlin Griffiths

programme.title: STV Racing: Live from Haydock
programme.desc: Ed Chamberlin presents coverage of a meeting headlined by the Betfair Chase from Haydock Park, plus racing from Ascot. Analysis comes from Sir AP McCoy and Leonna Mayor, reporting from Rishi Persad and Matt Chapman, and commentary from Richard Hoiles

programme.title: Tipping Point: Best Ever Finals
programme.desc: Compilation of some of the most dramatic endgames from the arcade-themed quiz show hosted by Ben Shephard, in which the last contestant standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot

programme.title: Bullseye
programme.desc: Freddie Flintoff hosts the revival of the classic darts-themed game show in which three teams of two, made up of a keen dart player and their quizzing partner combine to win points and prizes. Also joining the fun is world number one darts player Luke Humphries, who partners with Freddie to try and complete a charity challenge

programme.title: ITV News and Weather
programme.desc: Round-up of the latest headlines

programme.title: The Chase Celebrity Special
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh hosts as Lance Ellington, Beth Tweddle, Bob Champion and Sally Lindsay pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They must work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught

programme.title: Celebrity Catchphrase
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts a charity edition of the game show, with Ben Bailey Smith, Claire Richards and Lisa Riley all trying to say what they see, as they guess well-known phrases for the chance to win a £50,000 jackpot for their chosen good causes

programme.title: The 1% Club
programme.desc: Quiz game show hosted by Lee Mack in which the questions have nothing to do with remembering facts, but are all about logic and common sense. A hundred contestants begin every show, but who will make it to the end and answer a question only one per cent of the country can get right - and win up to £100,000?

programme.title: I'm a Celebrity Get Me Out of Here!
programme.desc: Ant and Dec present as the famous faces enter their second week in the Australian jungle, living off basic rations and competing in trials in the hope of winning food for camp and try to stay in the race to be crowned King or Queen of the jungle.

programme.title: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
programme.desc: Comedy game show in which celebrities team up with family members, with the parents choosing which questions their grown-up children will answer and gambling on how many they can get right. Alison Hammond's son Aidan comes close to damaging the family brand, and Carol Vorderman makes life difficult for her son Cameron. Romesh's mum Shanthi has her head turned by the sight of Iain Stirling in long johns, with the Love Island narrator being in a team with his mother

programme.title: The Jonathan Ross Show: Special Guests

programme.title: Scared to Death
programme.desc: 1947. Horror. Directed by Christy Cabanne. Stars Bela Lugosi, George Zucco & Molly Lamont. From the morgue, a young woman narrates the bizarre story of how she ended up there.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Next week, there's experiments, investigations and chilling horror, join Caroline Munro for a sneak peek.

programme.title: Road Games
programme.desc: 1981. Thriller. Directed by Richard Franklin. Stars Jamie Lee Curtis, Stacy Keach & Marion Edward. A truck driver in Australia begins to suspect that a man is killing young women along his route.

programme.title: The Place of the Dead
programme.desc: 1997. Adventure. Directed by Suri Krishnamma. Stars Greg Wise, Simon Dutton & Dougray Scott. A group of soldiers on a British Army expedition attempt to navigate an unexplored Malaysian gully.

programme.title: The Last Journey (1935)
programme.desc: 1935. Drama. Director: Bernard Vorhaus. Bob (Julien Mitchell) is distraught with his upcoming forced retirement and believes his wife is having an affair. The day arrives for his final journey.

programme.title: Stockport in 1959
programme.desc: Documentary on Stockport about habits and changes in shopping and buildings and a look at the residents - this is your Concern! Population when filmed was 5,000.

programme.title: The Night We Dropped a Clanger
programme.desc: 1959. A Wing Commander (Brian Rix) is on a mission to find out about the flying bomb. Stars William Hartnell, Leslie Phillips, Leo Franklyn & Liz Fraser.

programme.title: Look At Life Pilot Aboard
programme.desc: 1963. The captivating story of Britain's pilotage services to shipping.

programme.title: The Black Arrow
programme.desc: The Prophecy. 1972. Stars William Squire, Robin Langford & Helen Stronge. A mysterious knight resolves to protect the poor against those fighting for power during the War of the Roses.

programme.title: Space Patrol
programme.desc: The Water Bomb. 1963. Stars Ysanne Churchman, Ronnie Stevens & Dick Vosburgh. Captain Dart is sent on a rain-making mission to Mars, but political terrorists intercept his plans.

programme.title: Batman
programme.desc: Penguin's Disastrous End. 1977. Stars Adam West, Burt Ward & Alan Napier. The Penguin attempts his scheme's masterstroke, complete with an audacious means of escape no one will see coming.

programme.title: The Roy Rogers Show
programme.desc: Jailbreak. 1951. Stars Roy Rogers, Dale Evans & Pat Brady. A young man is wrongly accused of murder; Dale helps him escape so they can prove his innocence.

programme.title: Stingray
programme.desc: Stingray. 1964. Stars Ray Barrett, Robert Easton & David Graham. Investigating the loss of a submarine, the crew of Stingray are captured by the Aquaphibians and sentenced to death.

programme.title: William Tell
programme.desc: The Emperor's Hat. 1958. Stars Conrad Phillips, Willoughby Goddard & Jennifer Jayne. William is forced to show his renowned marksmanship with the crossbow by shooting an apple off his son's head.

programme.title: Richard the Lionheart
programme.desc: The Man Who Sold Pardons. 1963. Stars Dermot Walsh, Nigel Green & Robin Hunter. A charlatan posing as a monk is going through towns selling indulgences, bearing a forged document from the king!

programme.title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
programme.desc: Errand of Mercy. 1956. Stars Richard Greene, Victor Woolf & Archie Duncan. A herbalist looking for natural remedies to help the sick as Robin passes by but dies before he can complete the mission.

programme.title: Planet Outlaws
programme.desc: 1953. Sci-fi. Directors: Ford Beebe & Saul Goodkind. Stars Buster Crabbe, Constance Moore & Jackie Moran. Buck Rogers and his friend Buddy wake up 500 years in the future to an outlaw ruled world.

programme.title: One Step Beyond
programme.desc: The Visitor. 1960. Stars Joan Fontaine, Warren Beatty & John Newland. A woman intent on ending her marriage encounters a strange visitor who makes her think again.

programme.title: Twist or Stick
programme.desc: It's a 1960s twisting compilation see 'The Hollies' Shane Fenton & The Fentones, The Orchids, The Keytones, a lot of 'That Old Yeah, Yeah Feeling' and much more.

programme.title: The Good Die Young
programme.desc: 1954. Thriller. Director: Lewis Gilbert. Stars Robert Morley, Joan Collins, Laurence Harvey & Stanley Baker. A group of down-and-outs are holding up a post office van but things start to go wrong.

programme.title: The Ship That Died of Shame
programme.desc: (AKA PT Raiders) 1955. Thriller. Director Basil Dearden. Stars Richard Attenborough, George Baker and Bill Owen. A trio of ex-servicemen begin smuggling black market items into post-war Britain.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1956. The Case of the River Morgue. Directed by Montgomery Tully. Starring Hugh Moxey, Gordon Needham and Jane Welsh. The police are summoned when a dead body is stolen. (S1, E16)

programme.title: Maigret
programme.desc: A Crime For Christmas. 1961. Stars Rupert Davies, Heather Chasen & Barry Foster. Father Christmas displays a strange interest in the floorboards when visiting the house across from the Maigret's.

programme.title: A Family At War
programme.desc: Take It on Trust. 1971. Created by John Finch. Stars Colin Douglas, Colin Campbell & Roy Russell. The iconic seventies drama series continues with the third and final series. (S3, E08)

programme.title: Nights of Cabiria
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Director: Federico Fellini. Stars Giulietta, Francois Perier & Franca Marzi. A waifish prostitute only finds heartbreak while wandering the streets of Rome in search for love.

programme.title: The Brigitte Bardot Story
programme.desc: French actress and singer Brigitte Bardot rose to fame with films that challenged conservative norms. This documentary tells the story of her becoming an international icon and sex symbol.

programme.title: Miss Bikini
programme.desc: Made around 1951 a 'look' at the new style of swimsuit. The launch of the 'Bikini' and a Miss World Contest filled with devastatingly beautiful damsels and an outdated look at the female form.

programme.title: EuroTrash
